title: MEDA Weather Normalizer v2.1 Canonical Record
description: JSON Schema for one record of the Normalized JSONL dataset produced by meda_weather Normalizer v2.1. Each record represents one exact (Sol, SCLK) time point. Derived from the actual implementation in normalize.py, streaming.py, parser.py, and registry.py. SCLK is intentionally a string to preserve sub-millisecond precision that JSON numbers cannot represent without rounding.

sol.description: Mars Sol number, derived from the product file name.

sclk_s.description: Spacecraft Clock (SCLK) as a canonical decimal string. Never a JSON number. Format: no sign, no exponent, no leading zeros, no trailing fractional zeros. Example: '735849600' or '735849600.123'. Canonical rule: '100.0' and '100' both become '100'; '100.010' becomes '100.01'.

lmst.description: Local Mean Solar Time string, copied verbatim from the source CSV. Null when absent or empty in the source.

ltst.description: Local True Solar Time string, copied verbatim from the source CSV. Null when absent or empty in the source.

utc.description: UTC timestamp. Always null in Normalizer v2.1 output: UTC conversion requires SPICE SCLK+LSK kernels which are not available to the Normalizer.

measurements.description: Dictionary of canonical measurement names to measurement objects. Canonical names are defined in normalize.py CHANNEL_SPECS. Keys that are absent were either missing from the source data or fell into raw_channels/unmapped_channels. The same physical variable from different processing levels (calibrated vs derived) always has distinct canonical names (e.g. 'downward_lw_irradiance_cal_w_m2' vs 'downward_lw_irradiance_derived_w_m2').

quality.description: Dictionary of quality / flag column values keyed as '<PRODUCT>.<level>.<COLUMN>'. Values are preserved verbatim from the source CSV; no good/bad interpretation is applied. Keys include: uncertainty columns (any column containing 'UNCERTAINTY'), columns ending '_STABLE', and named flag columns (see FLAG_DEFINITIONS in normalize.py). Example key: 'WS.derived.ROVER_STILL'.

sources.description: List of provenance dicts for every contributing source row (one per CSV row that shared this exact Sol+SCLK). Never empty in a valid record.

raw_channels.description: Full verbatim channel set for products whose entire channel set is preserved (RDS, ENG, ATS). Keyed as '<PRODUCT>.<level>'. Only present when at least one such product contributed to this record.

raw_channel_issues.description: Validity flags for raw channel values that were not 'valid' (e.g. 'invalid_sentinel', 'unverified_sentinel_candidate'). Same key structure as raw_channels. Only present when at least one issue was detected.

unmapped_channels.description: Columns from non-raw-channel products that were not mapped to any canonical name. Keyed as '<PRODUCT>.<level>'. Only present when unmapped columns exist.

missing.description: Canonical measurement names that could not be built, with the reason. Reasons: 'empty_cell' (cell was None in source) or 'column_absent' (column not present in the CSV). Only contains measurements not present in the 'measurements' dict. Only present when at least one measurement was missing.

conflicts.description: List of conflict records where the same key appeared with differing content across contributing source rows. Kinds: 'duplicate_measurement', 'quality', 'time_metadata', 'raw_channels'. The first value encountered is kept in measurements/quality; the other is listed here. Only present when conflicts occurred.

quarantined_channels.description: Measurement channels that were isolated by channel_policy (ChannelDecision action='exclude'). These values are not in measurements. Only present when quarantine was applied.

measurement.description: One normalized measurement value with full provenance. The 'value' field is null when validity is 'invalid_sentinel' or 'non_numeric'; it is kept as given when validity is 'valid' or 'unverified_sentinel_candidate'.

value.description: Numeric measurement value or null. Null when validity is 'invalid_sentinel' or 'non_numeric'. Zero is a valid value and is never treated as missing.

unit.description: Short unit symbol (e.g. 'Pa', 'K', 'm/s', 'W/m2', 'ppm', 'deg'). Null when the XML label states no unit and the unit is unverified (e.g. relative humidity channels). See also unit_verified.

source_unit.description: Unit string exactly as found in the PDS4 XML label (e.g. 'pascal', 'kelvin'). Null when the label states no unit.

unit_basis.description: Evidence basis for the unit. 'label' = unit verified against the XML label. 'bundle_description' = from bundle description (not used by v2.1). 'not_stated' = label has no <unit> element.

validity.description: Classification of this measurement value. 'valid' = numeric value, not a sentinel. 'invalid_sentinel' = value matched a VERIFIED sentinel rule (value->null, raw_value preserved). 'unverified_sentinel_candidate' = value matches an UNVERIFIED sentinel rule (value kept, raw_value repeated, warning counted). 'non_numeric' = text found in a numeric channel.

source_level.description: Processing level of the source CSV. 'calibrated' or 'derived'.

source_file.description: Source CSV file name (without directory path).

source_row.description: Physical CSV line number (1-based, header = line 1). Null when line tracking is unavailable.

source_channel.description: Original CSV column name that produced this measurement (e.g. 'PRESSURE', 'HORIZONTAL_WIND_SPEED').

unit_verified.description: Present and false only when unit is null and unit_basis is 'not_stated'. Absent for measurements whose unit is verified from the label.

raw_value.description: Original value before sentinel substitution (number), or the offending text for non_numeric. Present only when validity is not 'valid'.

validity_reason.description: Human-readable explanation of why validity is not 'valid'. Only present when validity is NOT 'valid'.

uncertainty.description: Measurement uncertainty (1-sigma). Only present when the ChannelSpec declares an uncertainty column and the source CSV contains a non-null value for it.

allOf.description: normalize._build_measurement: value is nulled only for invalid_sentinel / non_numeric; otherwise the numeric value is kept.
normalize._build_measurement: raw_value and validity_reason are written whenever validity is not 'valid'.
normalize._build_measurement: unit_verified=false is written exactly when ChannelSpec.unit is None.

value.description: Numeric uncertainty value or null (null when validity is not 'valid').

unit.description: Unit symbol for the uncertainty value. May be null if the label states no unit.

source_channel.description: CSV column name containing the uncertainty value.

validity.description: Validity of the uncertainty value using the same vocabulary as measurement.validity.

raw_value.description: Original uncertainty value (number, or text when non_numeric). Present only when uncertainty validity is not 'valid'.

source_provenance.description: Provenance of one contributing CSV row.

release.description: Numeric release number extracted from the file name (e.g. 'P02' -> 2). Null when not determinable.

original_sclk.description: SCLK text exactly as found in the CSV, before canonical normalization.

source_archive.description: Source archive identifier. Present only when archive provenance is recorded.

conflict_record.description: One conflict entry. normalize.normalize_group writes 'key' for kinds duplicate_measurement / quality / raw_channels and 'field' (not 'key') for kind time_metadata. Remaining members (kept, other, other_source) vary by kind and are open.

key.description: Canonical measurement name, quality key, or '<PRODUCT>.<level>' key.

field.description: Time field name ('lmst' or 'ltst'); time_metadata conflicts only.

$comment: Contract notes derived from the v2.1 source. (1) The normalize.py module docstring does not list 'quarantined_channels' or 'unit_verified' although the code emits both; the code is authoritative. (2) unit_basis 'bundle_description' is allowed by ChannelSpec's documented vocabulary but no v2.1 channel uses it. (3) PS.derived PRESSURE_UNCERTAINTY: the label gives 'kelvin'; the Normalizer leaves the uncertainty unit null. (4) 'sources' entries may carry extra keys; only the keys the parser/streaming code writes are described. (5) Records are written in strictly increasing (sol, SCLK) order (streaming.validate_jsonl); this is not expressible per-record.
